analysis_metadata.reference_paper: Zeng et al. 2017 - Cognitive Mapping Based on Conjunctive Representation of Grid Cells and Head Direction Cells

usage_locations.note: Function name has typo in original codebase (accupancy vs occupancy)

occupancy_map_analysis.summary: Occupancy map is NOT a model input during training/inference. Used primarily for collision detection in robot controllers and path visualization. System 1 (NavDP) and System 2 (InternVLA-N1) work with RGB/depth images and latent goals, not occupancy maps.

injection_points.current_code: IMU encoder initialization with imu_linear layers
injection_points.proposed_modification: Add GridCellEncoder following same pattern as IMU encoder
injection_points.reason: RDP already has IMU encoder infrastructure - grid cells can follow identical pattern

injection_points.current_code: cond_embedding = torch.cat([time_embeds, goal_embed, goal_embed, goal_embed, rgbd_embed], dim=1)
injection_points.proposed_modification: Add grid_code to conditioning: cond_embedding = torch.cat([..., rgbd_embed, grid_code], dim=1)
injection_points.reason: Requires modifying positional encoding size and decoder architecture

injection_points.proposed_modification: Add grid_code: hidden_states = torch.cat([memory_tokens, traj_latents, grid_code], dim=1)
injection_points.reason: Trajectory generation conditioned on VLM latents - grid code adds path integration info

velocity_sources.info: S1Output dataclass has linear_velocity and angular_velocity fields
IMU data computed from global positions with local coordinate transformation

replacement_scenarios.name: Full Replacement
replacement_scenarios.description: Remove occupancy map entirely, use grid cells for all spatial reasoning
cons: Safety risk for real robot deployment

replacement_scenarios.name: Partial Replacement - Localization Only
replacement_scenarios.description: Grid cells for self-localization and progress tracking, keep occupancy for obstacles
pros: Precise path integration for distance traveled
Best for solving 'distance already traveled' problem
cons: Need to fuse two spatial representations

replacement_scenarios.name: Parallel Enhancement
replacement_scenarios.description: Add grid cells alongside occupancy map without removing anything
pros: Grid code as auxiliary conditioning signal

replacement_feasibility.recommended_approach: Start with Parallel Enhancement, then gradually transition to Partial Replacement based on performance metrics
critical_blockers: Grid cells cannot replace collision detection - they have no obstacle awareness
Depth sensor still needed for dynamic obstacle detection in real robot deployment
System 1's diffusion policy was trained without grid cell conditioning - may require fine-tuning
Velocity signal quality is crucial for accurate path integration

pros: Can be implemented from paper equations
cons: May not adapt to novel environments

implementation_plan.recommended_option: Zeng's Explicit Formula for initial integration, with option to upgrade to learned grid cells based on performance
priority_order: 3. Integrate with RDP policy (has IMU template)
7. Evaluate on real robot with Agilex platform

risks.risk: Grid cells drift without visual correction
risks.mitigation: Implement periodic visual recalibration using place cell matching from RGB features
NEVER remove occupancy-based collision detection; grid cells are supplementary only
Implement as optional module with backward compatibility; use feature flags

risks.risk: Training instability with learned grid cells
risks.mitigation: Use frozen explicit formulas initially; train only projection layers
Low-pass filtering; use odometry + IMU sensor fusion
Grid cell update is lightweight (~1ms); profile and optimize if needed

dependencies: Velocity signals available from simulation environment or ROS odometry
Optional: trajectory dataset with velocity annotations for learned approach
fallback_options: Feature flag to disable: model.grid_cell_encoder.use = False
Start with grid cells as auxiliary loss, not primary conditioning
A/B testing framework to compare with and without grid cells

conclusions.recommended_integration_strategy: Parallel Enhancement with gradual transition to Partial Replacement
key_benefits: Precise path integration for 'distance already traveled' estimation
Support for vector navigation and shortcut planning
key_limitations: Requires velocity signals (available in current system)
May need fine-tuning for existing trained models
actionable_next_steps: Create GridCellEncoder module with Zeng's explicit formula
Integrate with RDP policy using IMU encoder pattern
Test path integration accuracy in VLN-CE simulation
Evaluate impact on navigation success rate and SPL
